findings.title: Exposed debug configuration
findings.description: A development-oriented configuration appears to be exposed.
findings.evidence: The assessment identified a debug configuration exposed by the application response. This could reveal implementation details and diagnostic information to an unauthorized user.

findings.title: Exposed debug configuration
findings.description: The same development-oriented configuration was observed again during the assessment.
findings.evidence: A second scanner result reported the same debug configuration on the application.

findings.title: Missing security header
findings.description: A recommended HTTP security header is missing from the response.
findings.evidence: The application response did not include the expected security header.

findings.title: Informational version disclosure
findings.description: The application reveals version information in a response.
findings.evidence: Server response contained software version information that may help identify the deployed software.

findings.title: Weak session configuration
findings.description: The assessment indicates a potentially unsafe session configuration requiring urgent review.
findings.evidence: The assessment recorded a session-related configuration weakness with evidence associated with the authentication component.
